# The Crew of The Raptor's Talon

*Page PDF 9*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

## **The Crew of the Raptor’s Talon**
Captain Flariel and his crew sail on the Druchii ravenship, the _Raptor’s Talon_ , one of many vessels in Fleetmaster Duriath Helbane’s fleet. Helbane rules over his maritime command from the _Temple of Spite_ , an ancient black ark sheared from the coast of Ulthuan at the culmination of the Sundering. An encounter with the _Raptor’s Talon_ is a challenge for seaborne adventurers, although it pales in comparison to the towering menace of Helbane’s Black Ark. 

The _Temple of Spite_ is a floating citadel, sailing the oceans through terrible sorceries. Its vast stone bulk plays host to a whole army of Dark Elves and creatures of the deep, tamed to fight for Helbane and pull doomreaver ships under his command. The fleetmaster rules over a council of corsair captains, sorceresses, and dreadlords, who in turn command his fleet and legions. Each council member is free to reave and sail the seas as they see fit — until Helbane brings them to heel. They are fierce rivals who seek to outdo one another in despoiling Human settlements, seizing captives, and persecuting the Asur. 

Captain Flariel secured his place on the council through daring success at the Battle of Deloth’s Shoals, where he sank three eagleships from the High Elf fleet. In recent years, the _Raptor’s Talon_ has preyed on shipping and settlements around the Sea of Claws, from Lyonesse to Kislev, the Norscan coast and west to the mist-shrouded isle of Albion. Flariel is devious and independent, chafing under the command of Duriath Helbane. The fleetmaster plans to attack the High Elf outpost of Tor Elithis, hoping to sack the settlement and build a fortress on its ruins. Captain Flariel has no interest in this endeavour and seeks a way to leave Helbane’s control. 

He may have found an opportunity. The sorceress Rakaria joined the _Raptor’s Talon_ to search for Asur ruins and artefacts along the Old World coast. Flariel hopes, with patronage from Ghrond, he may be able to leave Helbane’s fleet. That said, relations between the captain and the sorceress are far from harmonious. 

## **Disposition**
The _Raptor’s Talon_ sails with a crew of 41 Dark Elves and 30 galley slaves. 

- Captain Flariel commands the vessel, assisted by his second-in-command Medus Hackwind ( _Chief Mate_ template) The crew respect Flariel — as long as he brings them plunder and adventure. Loyalty amongst Dark Elves is only ever conditional, and Flariel and Hackwind must remain alert for signs of mutiny. 

- Though sorceress Rakaria has no formal position in the ship’s hierarchy, her position in the Dark Covenant makes her a privileged guest and honorary officer. She stays in her cabin or surveys the coastline when the _Raptor’s Talon_ sails close to shore. Rakaria is assigned Khana from the ship’s crew as a servant. The sailor hopes to secure the sorceress’s patronage and enter into permanent service. 

- 20 Corsairs. These raiders plunder and pillage under Flariel’s command. They lead boarding actions and raiding parties, taking spoils and captives back to the ship. Their leader is Khilandra Darkthorn ( _Corsair_ template + _Champion_ Creature Trait), known for her inventive cruelties. 

- 15 Ship’s Crew and 2 eagle-eyed Lookouts. Dark Elf seamen are lower in status than corsairs. Each sailor serves many functions on board to keep the ship running — they pilot the ship, cook, serve Flariel and his officers, and effect repairs. The sailors are less enamoured of Captain Flariel than the corsairs, and take out their resentment on the captives. 

- Beastmaster Corvian is overseer of the captives ( _Oarsman_ template). These wretched souls man the oars and provide cruel sport for the Druchii crew. Amongst their number are Humans from Bretonnia, the Wasteland, the Empire, Norsca, and even Albion. A band of four Dwarf captives nurse their grievances with stoic resolve.
